verdict.rationale: Ramp's multi-entity product explicitly supports syncing transactions/reimbursements across multiple entities from a single consolidated account, with per-entity spend policies and controls, plus multi-currency reimbursements in 40+ currencies. However missing for 10: detailed evidence of true per-entity separate books/GL vs consolidated view, cross-entity consolidated financial reporting/statements, and independent hands-on verification of the multi-entity workflow beyond marketing copy.
